description: DNS records of a domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA) resolved live through the public AdGuard DNS JSON resolver (NextDNS as backup). Shows answers as they resolve now, with TTLs; it does not walk the delegation chain or query the authoritative servers directly. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_dns_caa_records when you need to list the CAA records published on a domain: which CAs may; security_dns_propagation when you need Asks two independent public DNS resolvers for the same name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

types.description: Comma list of record types from A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT,CNAME,CAA,SOA (default A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT)

name: security_dns_records
title: DNS records of a domain resolved live through the public
